name: sep-sales-wrapper
description: Android APK Capacitor Wrapper for SEP Sales App with Location, Camera, RawBT, and Direct Bluetooth Printing support

scripts.sync: npm run copy-dist && npx cap sync
scripts.build:apk: npm run copy-dist && npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat clean assembleProductionDebug
scripts.build:uat: npm run copy-dist && npm run sync:android && node scripts/apply-uat-config.js && cd android && gradlew.bat clean assembleUatDebug
